messages.subject: object 'temperaturecolumn' not found
parts:
Dear GGIR community,

I have a csv file with accelerometer data (g), temperature (C) and timestamps from a C3 Holter Monitor. I am able to successfully load the data using "read.myacc.csv". However, when I call GGIR ,with the same arguments, I receive an error. It seems to be able to load the data, but then gives the error:

"object 'temperaturecolumn' not found"

This error also arise when I leave out the temperature measurements. Have anyone else experienced this, and found a solution?

Best,

Jesper

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] object 'temperaturecolumn' not found
parts:
Dear Jesper,

I think this is a bug in GGIR, and I have now tried to fix it.
Would you mind trying it out by re-installing GGIR with the following commands:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "issue577_tempcolumn")
library(GGIR)

Thanks,

Vincent
